title: Evolutionary Anthropology
description: Explores evolutionary theory as applied to anthropological questions relevant to humans and non-human primates. Examines how foundational concepts and thinkers in Evolutionary Theory have shaped scientific and popular perceptions about humans and how evolutionary anthropologists are critically re-evaluating these models and their historical biases.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of ANTH456, ANTH484 (if taken in the same topic).
